meta.protocol: every fight dated 2026-01-01 or later dropped right after parsing (build_db.parse_fights wrapped); all choices by time-ordered CV on pre-2024 data (expanding window, validation blocks 2016-17, 2018-19, 2020-21, 2022-23; stacks forward-chained 2021-2023 from 2019); 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 scored once. static = models fit on fights before 2024-01-01; rolling = refit on the first of every month on all fights before it (stacks refit each January)

sources.ratings: tools/ratings.py systems rerun with its tuned parameters over 2009-2025 (check vs ratings.json: {'whr_rounds': 4.996505411758445e-05, 'glicko2': 4.999818493189867e-05, 'elo_full': 4.999445315390094e-05, 'trueskill_mov': 4.999674222072592e-05, 'whr_mov': 4.999973217534315e-05, 'elo_rounds': 4.9971768174061904e-05, 'whr_hybrid': 4.999674818118027e-05})
sources.market_rating: tools/market.py Kalman market rating rebuilt from 2013 (check vs market.json: {'n': 2855, 'max_abs_diff': 9.204512909755103e-05, 'share_gt_1e-3': 0.0})
sources.preufc: data/derived/preufc.json strict snapshots (tools/preufc.side_pre), target rule applied pre-fight
sources.late (stage2): durability.json, oppadj.json, mlrates_oof.json, methodround.json, styles.py terms (styles.json archetypes) (2019+ only)

meta.orientation: P(A wins | decisive), A = first ufcstats name; every model is corner-symmetric

keys.fights: per backtest fight id 2019-2025: set (oof = 2019-2023 annual refit, valid = 2024-2025), y, ml2 (blend: LR + LightGBM + XGBoost), ml2_lr, ml2_lgb, ml2_xgb, mr (market rating), ml2_roll / ml2_lr_roll (monthly rolling refit, valid only), stack_<regime>_<scheme> (current+ml2 stacks, valid only)
keys.page_model: logistic ML v2 for any two roster fighters (src/ml/ml2.js)
